pageProps.content: ## Review A stop for lunch during the Great Ocean Road tour. The guide had a separate restaurant recommendation, but I was in the mood for something breakfast-like, so I found this place myself. The eggs were fluffy and soft — really good. The croissant was surprisingly much better than expected. ```adcard ``` Plenty of locals were dropping by for takeout lunch, and the tables inside were all full. It was quite cold that day, which somehow made the coffee taste even better. Located right in front of Apollo Bay beach, it's known for its artisan croissants and specialty coffee. ## Pictures
